policy_basis: RFC 7235 section 2.2: protection-space scheme and authority
Requests 2.20.0/2.20.1 release notes: downgrade stripping/default-port retention
Requests documented-in-source HTTP-to-HTTPS compatibility exception; library-specific, not RFC rule
normative_status: analyst-defined finite interpretation; not maintainer approval or universal verification
execution: real Requests Session.get with an in-memory HTTPAdapter; no network I/O
core_mutation_operators: return replacement by True or False
sensitivity_operator: delete one if statement, including its body
mutant_denominator: all structurally distinct, executable mutants killed by the complete finite domain; survivor and error counts also reported

selection.objective: minimum number of distinct finite-domain test rows, exact MILP
criteria: branch arcs + core mutants + seven policy-category IDs
branch arcs + core and if-deletion mutants
selection.human_cost: not measured; test-row count is an explicit size objective, not review or maintenance effort
selection.tie_rule: secondary minimization of case-ID sum at the minimum cardinality
selection.evaluation: after freezing reductions: historical failures retained, requirement/category coverage, finite-row omissions
selection.optimal_solution_sensitivity: test feasibility of omitting each historical failure class at the fixed minimum size; historical outcomes used only for evaluation
